[[File:Wizard's mind bomb detail.png|left|130px]]
The '''wizard's mind bomb''' is a type of [[ale]] that restores 1 [[Hitpoints|Hitpoint]] and [[Temporary skill boost|temporarily boosts]] [[Magic]] by +2 (+3 if level 50+ Magic) while [[Temporary skill drain|draining]] [[Attack]], [[Strength]] and [[Defence]] by <math>\lfloor Level \times 0.05\rfloor + 1</math> (see table below). It can be obtained through [[brewing]] at level 34 [[Cooking]], granting 314 experience per batch. It is brewed using 2 [[Bucket of water|buckets of water]], 2 [[barley malt]], 4 [[yanillian hops]], and a pot of [[ale yeast]]. It can also be bought from several shops.

The stronger, mature version of the ale is the [[mature wmb]].

It is required for the quest [[Dragon Slayer I]], and may also be used in [[Below Ice Mountain]] in place of a regular [[beer]].

{{Instructions
|step1 = Use 2 [[bucket of water]] on the [[fermenting vat]]
|step2 = Use 2 [[barley malt]] on the fermenting vat
|step3 = ''Optional:'' Use 1 [[the stuff]] on the fermenting vat, increasing the chance to mature the ale from 5% to 64%
|step4 = Use 4 [[yanillian hops]] on the fermenting vat
|step5 = Use 1 [[ale yeast]] on the fermenting vat
|step6 = Wait 1 to 1.5 days (or up to 5 days if the stuff was used) until the beer has fermented
|step7 = Use 8 [[beer glass]]es on the completed ale in the fermenting vat
}}
